hook: Winning at Anfield is rare for Arsenal, but this 1-0 victory defied all historical logic.

sections.voiceover: Winning at Anfield is rare for Arsenal, but this 1-0 victory defied all historical logic.
Arsenal secured a 1-0 victory at Anfield, ending a 14-year winless streak at the stadium. How did they hold Liverpool scoreless?
Yet, Liverpool failed to register a single shot on target during the entire Premier League match.
This lack of shots on target is a first since records began in the 2003 season. Arteta successfully neutralized the entire Liverpool attack at home.
This 1-0 win stands as Arsenal's most significant tactical triumph at Anfield in 14 years.
